title: Refining a Batch
text:
A batch can use a single plant or several, as long as it meets the recipe requirements. There is no general minimum or maximum number of species.


T1, T2 and T3 recipes require at least one plant of their tier or higher.


Stacking lower-tier plants cannot satisfy this requirement: each plant's own spiritual growth determines its tier (T2: 100; T3: 1,000).


Each plant contributes its spiritual growth multiplied by stack count to its element's score. Qi-source reserves do not count toward these scores.


Every input stack is consumed when the batch finishes.


Missing mandatory requirements ruins the batch. Even a correct recipe can fail.


Failed batches cause a small explosion that damages nearby creatures and the refiner, without breaking blocks or starting fires.


Each recipe also has its own refinement Qi cost and difficulty. Read Failure and Recipe Difficulty for the success calculation; plant count alone does not raise difficulty.
